video_title: "I Just Provided What The Team Needed From Me." | Terrence Shannon Jr Post Game Sound | 11.16.26

quotes.speaker: Terrence Shannon Jr
quotes.summary_phrase: Terrence Shannon Jr on his mindset and attacking in transition
quotes.excerpt: I just feel like my best game is when I'm in transition and I just did a good job attacking it.
quotes.quote: Just be myself. I don't really have a mindset for them. I feel like my best game is when I'm in transition and I just did a good job attacking it.
quotes.social_post: Terrence Shannon Jr says his best game comes when he is in transition and attacking the rim.

structured.context: Terrence Shannon Jr discusses his approach to playing in transition after the game.

quotes.speaker: Terrence Shannon Jr
quotes.summary_phrase: Terrence Shannon Jr on reading the floor and playmaking
quotes.excerpt: Just reading the floor, knowing when to create, knowing when to attack, go to the rim.
quotes.quote: Just reading the floor, knowing when to create, knowing when to attack, go to the rim, and if the paint collapse, kick it out or try to find a dump off to my teammates.
quotes.social_post: Terrence Shannon Jr on his playmaking approach: I am just reading the floor, knowing when to create, knowing when to attack, and if the paint collapses, kick it out.

structured.context: Terrence Shannon Jr explains his decision-making process when reading the floor and playmaking.

quotes.speaker: Terrence Shannon Jr
quotes.summary_phrase: Terrence Shannon Jr on his development as a playmaker
quotes.excerpt: I recently had a talk with Chris Finch about me creating for others.
quotes.quote: I always could pass. I recently had a talk with Chris Finch about me creating for others, and that's something I'm trying to do a better job at, balancing that and attacking.
quotes.social_post: Terrence Shannon Jr says he had a talk with Chris Finch about focusing more on creating for others while balancing his own scoring.

structured.context: Terrence Shannon Jr discusses his development as a playmaker following a conversation with head coach Chris Finch.

quotes.speaker: Terrence Shannon Jr
